'''Cho'Kri''' was the name of a [[Vorn tiger]] kept in the [[Palace of the Eternal Dragon]] on [[Zakuul]] during the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]] in [[3630 BBY]]. After the Eternal Empress [[Vaylin]]'s speech was interrupted by the arrival of the [[Alliance Commander]] and the former Emperor [[Arcann]], [[Beastmaster/Legends|Beast master]] [[Oleg (Zakuul)|Oleg]] went to combat invading Arcann's loyalists, accompanied by Cho'Kri and another vorn tiger named [[Cho'Ale]]. They were all killed during the three-way fighting in the Palace reception area.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cho'Kri appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during '''"Chapter VI: The Dragon's Maw"'''.
